notes.title: “SHANHAI: Myth Origins” Demo is now officially released
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="5E1wnq5d_Us;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hello, Adventurers!
We’re excited to announce that the SHANHAI: Myth Origins Demo is officially live! Heartfelt thanks to everyone who joined the Playtest—your suggestions and feedback have greatly helped us improve the game. With the Demo going live, the Playtest will be closed in the near future (after closure, it will no longer be available for download or updates). Please switch to the Demo to continue playing, share your feedback, and add the game to your Wishlist to support us! With your companionship, the scroll of the Shanhaijing has officially unfurled.
Download and play the Demo


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639350/_/"][/dynamiclink]Add the game to your Wishlist (very important!)

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540450/_/"][/dynamiclink]

2 full stages + 2 Divine-Beast Bosses: a more complete flow with tuned pacing
• New character — the archer “Hanshuang”: high mobility, high attack speed, and burst damage
• All-new Fa-Bao system: collect and unleash the power of legendary artifacts (e.g., Dinghai Shenzhen, Dingfeng Zhu, Juling Fu)
• Exotic-beast capture (Juling Fu): seal beasts into bronze statues and summon them to aid you in battle
• New map “Misty Forest”: encounter more creatures inspired by the Shanhaijing
We will continue iterating on Demo content and values based on everyone’s gameplay data and feedback. Please stay tuned for upcoming patch notes.

About the Playtest closure
• Why close it?
The Playtest aimed to validate core gameplay and stability with a smaller audience; with the Demo now officially released, we’re unifying the entry point to the Demo to centralize feedback and version maintenance.
• What should existing Playtest players do?
Simply download and launch the Demo from the Store page to keep playing. The Playtest will no longer be maintained or updated.
• Will data carry over?
Progress and data from the test period are not guaranteed to carry over to the Demo/full release (subject to in-game announcements). Please treat the Demo as the main branch for future play and feedback.

FAQ
• Q1: What’s the difference between the Demo and the Playtest?
A: The Demo is a public build with more stable content and a more complete experience; subsequent fixes and tuning will prioritize the Demo.
• Q2: How often will the Demo be updated?
A: We’ll roll out updates based on issue severity and feedback priority. Major updates will be announced via Steam News and on Discord.
• Q3: Will the system requirements change?
A: Optimization is ongoing. Please keep your GPU drivers and OS up to date; if you encounter performance/crash issues, report them in our Discord #bug-report channel (include hardware, OS version, GPU driver, reproduction steps, and logs).
• Q4: Does the Demo support co-op?
A: Yes. The Demo supports up to 4-player co-op to challenge Divine-Beast Bosses—bring your friends!

Developers’ Note
Thank you to every player who offered valuable feedback during the Playtest—you made SHANHAI: Myth Origins better. The Demo is just the beginning of a new journey. We’ll continue polishing combat feel, balance, Fa-Bao builds, multi-language localization, and network stability. Please keep the feedback coming and share your epic moments!

Thank you again for your support—see you in the Demo!

notes.title: Version update: v1.1.8
notes.content:
New content:

A model for merchants has been newly added.



Content adjustment:

Adjusted and optimized issues related to characters getting stuck and being able to exit combat scenarios.

notes.title: Version update: v1.1.7
notes.content:
New content:

Newly added are the Samsung purple sword and staff.



Content adjustment:

The level of the item has been adjusted, for example, from ++ to a five-pointed star.

The UI for selecting props has been adjusted.

Adjusted the prompt UI for item pickup.

The base attack power of swords and staffs has been adjusted.



Issue fix:

Fixed the issue of weapon duplication.

notes.title: V1.1.6 version update
notes.content:
Content adjustment:

Adjusted the blood bar UI effect of BOSS.

Adjusted the UI effect of displaying prop names.



Problem fix:

Fixed the issue of weapon duplication.

Fixed the issue of character walking.

Fixed the issue where the treasure chest near the portal could not be picked up.

notes.title: V1.1.4 version update
notes.content:
Content adjustment:

Added the function of saving the selected language.

Adjusted the function of the delay button for returning to the village in the game.



Problem fix:

Fixed the issue of game lag.

Fixed the issue of unfinished battles when the game failed.

Fixed the issue of automatic secondary weapon attack when a character dies.

notes.title: V1.1.3 version update
notes.content:
Content adjustment:

Optimized the particle effects on the Fire Tiger, allowing for smoother operation.

Added and optimized 3 achievements.

Added character level display.



Problem fix:

Fixed the issue of exotic beasts refreshing underground.

Fixed the skill judgment issue for bosses.

notes.title: V1.1.2 version update
notes.content:
Content adjustment:

Remove the TAB key and use the B key to open the backpack uniformly; The relevant teaching content will be adjusted synchronously.

Adjust the settings panel and add sound control functionality.

Adjusted the giant spirit body mode and the attack rhythm of the Fire Tiger.

Adjusted the giant spirit body mode, the health of the Fire Tiger will change with the number of players.



Problem fix:

Fixed the issue where Fire Tiger's skills remained effective even after its death.

notes.title: Version update: v1.1.1
notes.content:
Content adjustment: 

Temporarily remove the detection of treasure chests when switching levels. 

Update the character's walkable algorithm. 

Reduce the water level to prevent players from walking on the water. 

The game has changed its default RHI from DirectX12 to DirectX11. 



Issue Fix:  

The issue of the client not displaying settlement results has been resolved. 

Fixed an issue where multiple players would affect the activation of item pickup. 

Fixed the issue where players would be knocked flying when they died.
